item.title: The Path for Testing Path Traversal Vulnerabilities with Python
item.description:
I have noticed an odd behavior in the requests module in Python, which uses urllib3. I inspected the root cause via regression testing, and I found that the root cause was a change introduced in urllib3.

import requests
requests.get("http://127.0.0.1/../../../../doing/certain/check")

Which should typically send the request to the following path: /../../../doing/certain/check. Instead, it requests /doing/certain/check and modifies the specified input.

The reason is dot segments escaping, following RFC3986.

The change to normalize URIs was introduced in this commit[1] to follow RFC3986[2]. The change is based on the “Remove Dot Segments” at the RFC.
